subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a channel/session-scoped `/agent <name>` switch for configured agents, and what authorization and visibility contract controls which agents a channel sender can list or select?
rationale: The feature crosses channel command handling, route resolution, session persistence, per-agent workspaces, tools, credentials, and sandbox policy, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
options.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving per-agent workspace, memory, sandbox, and tool boundaries.

options.title: Keep Static Routing Plus Focus
options.body: Decline direct configured-agent switching and keep bindings, `/focus`, `agents_list`, and `sessions_spawn` as the supported multi-agent paths.

options.title: Expose A Plugin/API Seam First
options.body: Design a generic agent-picker or route-override SDK contract before any channel implements visible switching.

recommendation.title: Design Guarded Session Switch
recommendation.body: Add a core-supported session override that lists and switches only authorized configured agents while preserving per-agent workspace, memory, sandbox, and tool boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest feature-history signal for multi-agent routing and the agents command surface.
